527:t_017:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You're alone and helpless! We can do whatever we want with the $$新地球皇国$$ backing us! How can you possibly win?!」

527:t_017:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Be quiet, you filthy stray dog.」

527:t_017:5.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You're calling me a stray dog with that pretty girl's voice?!」

527:t_017:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We aren't the only ones who will never give up fighting.」

527:t_017:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have no intention of kissing the boots of condescending, self-styled rulers like you assholes!」

527:t_017:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are not alone and helpless... $$相良$$, a dependable partner will reach you shortly.」

527:t_017:11.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Before then, you'll say goodbye to this world!」

527:t_018:2.en:
$n
「Sorry. I'm another of those people Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ mentioned who won't give up.」

527:t_019:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「This machine is... It can't be...」

527:t_019:1.en:
$$アル$$
「It has been a while, Sergeant.」

527:t_019:3.en:
$$アル$$
「That is correct. However, this unit's name is $$ＡＲＸ－８　レーバテイン$$.」

527:t_019:6.en:
$$アル$$
「The machine seized by $$アマルガム$$ was a dummy to conceal this unit's existence.」

527:t_019:7.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant $$相良$$... I request permission for you to return to war.」

527:t_020:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I don't like it! Something about that machine... I don't like it!!」

527:t_021:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What the hell is that power?!」

527:t_021:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's beyond anything an AS should be capable of...」

527:t_021:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Ghh... I'm blacking out...?! $$アル$$! Adjust the output...!」

527:t_021:4.en:
$$アル$$
「That was eighty percent. Did you enjoy it?」

527:t_021:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Actually, since this machine was built in secret, it has hardly undergone any test runs.」

527:t_021:8.en:
$$アル$$
「This machine was built secretly under extremely restricted conditions.」

527:t_021:9.en:
$$アル$$
「I requested operational tests at a training ground, but Mr. $$ハンター$$ rejected them.」

527:t_021:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ハンター$$... You mean Intelligence's $$ギャビン・ハンター$$?」

527:t_021:12.en:
$$アル$$
「Thus, naturally, it is also unknown whether the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ will function.」

527:t_021:14.en:
$$アル$$
「He is coming. That color... The enemy operator may be the $$赤い彗星$$.」

527:t_021:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you think Colonel $$シャア$$ is?!」

527:t_021:16.en:
$$アル$$
「As I believe you know, the enemy machine has a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. If possible, this unit should also...」

527:t_021:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't care anymore! We'll test it right now!」

527:t_022:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes...! We can use the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ too!」

527:t_022:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I have just confirmed it. In your current condition, Sergeant, you appear able to fight with the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ continuously active.」

527:t_022:3.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I won't forgive you! I won't forgive you, new model!!」

527:t_023:0.en:
$$アル$$
「He appears to be holding his machine together with the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$.」

527:t_023:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「He is as abnormal as ever.」

527:t_023:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$アル$$... I welcome your return.」

527:t_023:6.en:
$$アル$$
「It seems you learned to tell jokes while I was absent, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

527:t_023:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have demonstrated my growth. Now it is your turn.」

527:t_023:9.en:
$$アル$$
「I understand. Then let us go out with a bang.」

527:t_024:0.en:
$n
「I'll cover you. Go all out, $$宗介$$.」

527:t_025:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「We'll slaughter them in three minutes.」

527:t_025:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Let's do this, partner! No one can stand against us!!」

527:t_026:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy's destruction is confirmed, but neither Miss $$千鳥$$ nor $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

527:t_026:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we have shown $$アマルガム$$ our resolve. That is enough for now.」

527:t_026:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$アル$$, how many minutes did it take?」

527:t_026:3.en:
$$アル$$
「We finished within three minutes, as declared. That was splendid, Sergeant.」

527:t_026:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「That much was a piece of cake.」

527:t_026:5.en:
$n
「Don't talk like you did it all yourself.」

527:t_026:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's right. We only managed it because we all worked hard.」

527:t_026:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「But, well... I'm glad you're safe, $$アル$$.」

527:t_026:10.en:
$$アル$$
「Yes, Sergeant. I am glad too.」

527:t_026:11.en:
$$アル$$
「I want you to know that, at least, comes from my heart.」

527:t_026:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hmph... You talk about your heart, even though you're a machine...」

527:t_026:13.en:
$$宗介$$
(It's like a conversation between comrades in arms, but strangely, it doesn't feel bad...)

527:t_026:14.en:
$$マオ$$
「I've spotted a machine to the north-northeast! It's using $$ＥＣＳ$$ to escape from here!」
